description: distribution grid recorded waves is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yechen HAN. The dataset includes the recorded waves of fault indicators deployed in a city distribution grid in 2021. Each sheet represents the recording data of a fault indicator. Each row represents a sample, and the physical meaning of data is shown in the header. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 952517 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
